resources.string: Choose the voice that plays each character, and the narrator, when reading with Gemini TTS. Characters that appear in a chapter are added here automatically with a suggested voice: change it once and it sounds the same in every chapter.
On: each chapter read in full is saved as a WAV in %s (inside the download path, next to the generated epubs). Off: the audio is only kept for 3 days so you can listen again without regenerating it.
Hello, this is how I will sound while reading your novel.
Gemini TTS needs the Gemini API key (set it in the translation tab).
Could not identify the speakers; the dialogue will use a generic voice.
Could not save the chapter audio.

Saves requests: consecutive sentences (up to 2 voices) are generated together and the audio is split again per sentence. If the cut is not clean, that batch is redone sentence by sentence automatically.
Grouping turned off: the voice model did not leave clear pauses between sentences.
Gemini voice selected. Close this panel and press the speaker button to start reading aloud.
Generate the whole chapter before reading

Minimum requests: all the lines of each actor are generated together (a few big requests per chapter) and put back in text order. Reading starts when the chapter is ready (it can take a few minutes). Off: it starts sooner but spends many more requests.
Copy it from AI Studio > Rate limits. 0 = no limit. Free tier of Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS: 3 per minute, 10 per day.
Generating the chapter audio… reading starts when it is ready.
This chapter will use about %1$d requests (left today: %2$d).
This chapter needs about %1$d requests and only %2$d are left today (limit %3$d). Change the limit in Actors if your quota is higher.
Daily Gemini TTS quota reached. Try again tomorrow or change the limit in Actors.
Not enough quota to generate this chapter audio. Reading stopped.
